$comment: §303c fieldmap SCHEMA v2 — every property lives under an explicit source{} or target{} block. source = where the value comes from (CEH here — CEH is ALWAYS the master for this integration; stage 3 dropped). target = where it is written and how the operator sees it (target.gui = the label in the TARGET's admin GUI; ops mails speak these names). Rule properties per field: compare (String|MultiLine|Integer|Object|Array — the generic valid-vs-changed rule), capability (CreateOnly|CreateAndUpdate|GuiOnly), read (List|DetailOnly|NotReadable — where the target echoes the value back), direction (Outbound|Inbound, default = file direction), limitations (free-text per-field constraints). Loaded fail-soft at host startup over the ZohoFieldMap code defaults. SPEAKER slice live; Sessions/Sponsors migrate here next.

source.timezone: DateTimeOffset with the REAL offset of the event timezone for that date (e.g. +01:00 CET / +02:00 CEST).
source.notes: CEH is ALWAYS the master for this integration (operator 2026-07-24; stage 3 read-back dropped).

target.timezone: Event configured to the event timezone; the API takes/returns UTC ('…Z' start_time) and the GUI renders event-local time. §305: a correctly-offset CEH value converts exactly via ToUniversalTime — never send a wall-clock as if it were UTC.
